answer: Agents bond stake before joining a Semaphore membership tree and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose commitments bind each identity to its rate-limit nullifier. A canyon of Sybil accounts gains no extra quota without more collateral. If one identity sends beyond its limit, distinct messages reuse the nullifier; their proofs expose Shamir shares that reconstruct its private key, enabling immediate slashing. The lagoon of valid traffic remains open to honest members, while the grove of duplicate claims is economically discouraged.
